title: benkara armigera
intro: Benkara armigera, commonly known as Indian spurge or greater Indian spurge, is a plant species in the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Benkara armigera include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating wounds, skin infections, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of Benkara armigera include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
